name_note: Many genomes GTDB places in Lentihominibacter carry the older NCBI names Eubacterium or Candidatus Allocopromorpha.

sentences.text: Lentihominibacter is a bacterial genus detected in human faecal microbiota.
Among 346 older Korean adults grouped by cognitive status, the Alzheimer's disease group uniquely harboured Lentihominibacter.
A 12-week randomised placebo-controlled trial in healthy adults reported enrichment of Lentihominibacter hominis in gut microbiota profiling.
